findings.description: At phone width (360px) the table has min-width 760px but main uses overflow-x: clip, so the Amount and Actions columns are cut off and cannot be scrolled to. Viewers cannot see any amounts per expense, and editors cannot reach Edit/Delete on a phone. Keyboard focus on Delete also lands off-screen (x≈600-670 in a 360px viewport).
repro: Sign in as viewer (or editor) at 360px viewport width
Only Title and Category columns are visible; Amount and Actions are clipped and there is no horizontal scroll

findings.description: The Amount column header is right-aligned but the amount values are left-aligned, so the header sits far from its values and the amounts do not line up as a right-aligned currency column.
repro: Sign in and open /expenses at 1280px width
Compare the 'Amount' header position (right edge of the column) with the $ values (left edge of the column)

notes: Tested viewer and editor at 1280 and 360 widths on list, add, edit, filter, 404 pages. Did not test form submission validation in depth.

cost.notes: estimate from 23555 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0047-$0.0565
